description: This file defines the Schema class for PostgreSQL database schema management within Drupal, implementing methods for table creation, alteration, indexing, constraints, and metadata handling specific to PostgreSQL.

classes.name: Schema
classes.description: PostgreSQL implementation of \\Drupal\\Core\\Database\\Schema, providing methods for schema manipulation tailored to PostgreSQL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Schema object, setting default schema based on connection options.

methods.name: ensureIdentifiersLength
methods.description: Ensures schema object identifiers do not exceed PostgreSQL's maximum length, hashing if necessary.

methods.name: queryTableInformation
methods.description: Fetches blob columns and sequences used in a specific table by querying PostgreSQL system catalogs.

methods.name: getTempNamespaceName
methods.description: Retrieves PostgreSQL's temporary namespace name.

methods.name: resetTableInformation
methods.description: Clears cached table metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: queryFieldInformation
methods.description: Retrieves constraints related to a specific table column.

methods.name: createTableSql
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create a table with specified schema.

methods.name: createFieldSql
methods.description: Creates SQL for defining a table column based on schema specifications.

methods.name: processField
methods.description: Adjusts field schema for PostgreSQL specifics, including type mapping and unsigned handling.

methods.name: getFieldTypeMap
methods.description: Returns mapping from generic schema types to PostgreSQL-specific data types.

methods.name: _createKeySql
methods.description: Generates SQL for key expressions, supporting substring operations.

methods.name: createPrimaryKeySql
methods.description: Creates SQL for primary and unique keys, ignoring key length support in PostgreSQL.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the current schema.

methods.name: findTables
methods.description: Finds tables matching a pattern, considering table prefixes.

methods.name: renameTable
methods.description: Renames a table, including associated indexes and sequences.

methods.name: dropTable
methods.description: Drops a table if it exists.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Adds a new column to a table, handling primary keys, defaults, comments, and cache reset.

methods.name: dropField
methods.description: Removes a column from a table.

methods.name: fieldExists
methods.description: Checks if a column exists in a table.

methods.name: indexExists
methods.description: Checks if an index exists on a table.

methods.name: constraintExists
methods.description: Checks if a constraint (primary key, foreign key, etc.) exists.

methods.name: addPrimaryKey
methods.description: Adds a primary key constraint to a table.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKey
methods.description: Drops the primary key constraint from a table.

methods.name: findPrimaryKeyColumns
methods.description: Retrieves columns that form the primary key of a table.

methods.name: addUniqueKey
methods.description: Adds a unique constraint to a table.

methods.name: dropUniqueKey
methods.description: Drops a unique constraint from a table.

methods.name: addIndex
methods.description: Creates an index on a table.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops an index from a table.

methods.name: introspectIndexSchema
methods.description: Retrieves index schema details for a table.

methods.name: changeField
methods.description: Alters a column's schema, including type, default, nullability, comments, and sequences.

methods.name: _createIndexSql
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating an index.

methods.name: _createKeys
methods.description: Creates primary, unique, and index keys based on schema definitions.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves comments for tables or columns.

methods.name: hashBase64
methods.description: Generates a PostgreSQL-safe base64-encoded SHA-256 hash.

methods.name: extensionExists
methods.description: Checks if a PostgreSQL extension is installed.

methods.name: getSequenceName
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence name associated with a serial column.
